plugins.name: sidequests
plugins.description: 37 project-agnostic Claude Code skills + agent-ops runbooks distilled from real projects. Agent orchestration (fable-fleet-orchestration, agent-task-pickup, agent-coordination-gates, anti-idle-anti-stall, two-agent-build-test-loop, agentic-best-practices); independent review and reporting (cross-agent-review); watchers & durable automation (watcher-reliability, watcher-cleanup, durable-claude-automation, shipment-watch); agile-scrum SDLC and backlog upkeep (feature, bugfix, releasing, receipts, backlog-hygiene, ui-copy-trim); context & memory (session-context, memory-compaction, context-engine); usage & cost (usage-limit-guard, github-actions-cost-control); gaming rig, handhelds & desktop (steam-shortcut, hdr-gaming-setup, display-off-shortcut, isolated-streaming-host-mock, game-mod-setup, game-render-injection, settings-ab-test, network-stutter-triage, windows-host-cleanup, handheld-ftp-backup, machine-config-journal); and media perception & migration (video-understanding, source-finder, game-walkthrough, photo-reconciler).
